name: hash
description: Share a secret by short link. Client-side encrypted, password-protected, zero-knowledge.

scripts.dev:node: npm run build:server && ENVIRONMENT=development RATE_LIMIT_PEPPER=development-only-pepper STORAGE=sqlite DATABASE_PATH=./data/hash.sqlite PORT=8080 STATIC_ROOT=./dist/client node dist/server/adapters/node/main.js
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server && npm run build:worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run types && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build:client && npm run test:unit && npm run test:storage && npm run test:worker && npm run test:e2e
